training_method.objective_quote: Fine-tuned for Psychologically Safe & Persuasive Emotional Support

description.text:
EmpathLM is a fine-tuned version of SmolLM2-135M-Instruct trained to generate responses that combine Motivational Interviewing (MI) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles.

Unlike general-purpose language models, EmpathLM is specifically optimized to: Validate emotions without judgment; Reflect feelings back to the person warmly; Gently shift perspective without being manipulative; Ask powerful open questions that encourage self-reflection; Never give unsolicited advice.

output_type.quote: You are EmpathLM — an emotionally intelligent AI trained in Motivational Interviewing and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. When someone shares emotional pain:

use_claim.quote: trained to generate responses that combine Motivational Interviewing (MI) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles.

serving.text_only_input_quote: {"role": "user", "content": "I failed my exam again. I feel like I'm just not smart enough."}
serving.system_prompt: You are EmpathLM — an emotionally intelligent AI trained in Motivational Interviewing and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. When someone shares emotional pain: Validate their feelings without judgment. Reflect their emotions back to them. Ask one powerful open-ended question. NEVER give unsolicited advice.
serving.notes: generation_config.json has no temperature, top_p, or do_sample. The card example sets max_new_tokens 200 and temperature 0.7. config.json max_position_embeddings is 8192; the card's training max sequence length is 512. chat_template.jinja inserts "You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face" when the first message is not a system message. The demo at spaces/maliksaad/empathLM-demo loads maliksaad/empathLM with max_new_tokens 200, do_sample true, temperature 0.7. The uploaded weight file is float32 model.safetensors and there is no adapter_config.json. https://github.com/maliksaad/empathLM returns 404.

evaluation_reported.text: EmpathLM was benchmarked against GPT-4o-mini and a Groq baseline on 20 unseen test situations, scored across: emotional_validation, advice_avoidance, perspective_shift, and overall_empathy.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are empty, and the card never names a loss. Inventory dataset and parent match the card. The dataset viewer split is 180 train and 20 test, which matches the card's "~180 (90% of 200)". The linked GitHub repository returns 404, so the benchmark numbers the card points to are not on that page.
